scenarios.title: Adapt N adds N +1/+1 counters only if the permanent has none

setup.notes: In the has_plus_counter and other_counter_type variants the Hybrid starts with the counter named in the delta.

decisions: A activates Sauroform Hybrid's adapt ability (Adapt 4), tapping all six Forests.
Both players pass; the ability resolves.

variants.label: no_counters
variants.expected: Sauroform Hybrid gets four +1/+1 counters and is 6/6.

variants.label: has_plus_counter
variants.delta: Sauroform Hybrid already has one +1/+1 counter.
variants.expected: The ability resolves and no counters are added. Sauroform Hybrid keeps its single +1/+1 counter and is 3/3.

variants.label: other_counter_type
variants.delta: Sauroform Hybrid already has one charge counter and no +1/+1 counter.
variants.expected: A charge counter does not stop adapt: Sauroform Hybrid gets four +1/+1 counters and is 6/6 with one charge counter.
